play: draft BI-3 capability 5 (Fix defects test first)
question: Where does a bug sit in the plan, and can one be made where nothing is built?
answer: A bug is a defect under the story whose work brought it in, also when it is found later; it is never made where nothing is built. So the fix starts from a bug gathered under a plan item, and a defect in code no story built is named as not decided.

play: draft BI-3 capability 5 (Fix defects test first)
question: May the agent that traces a defect fall back to the AI model's own reasoning when memory has no answer?
answer: No. An agent that works through the memory tool never falls back to the model; it raises a memory update for a person. The bug fix play's design agent does fall back, so the pages name it as built against the rule.

play: draft BI-3 capability 5 (Fix defects test first)
question: May the builder of a fix see the tests that prove the defect?
answer: No. The builder never sees a test; the separate check tells it which results still fail. The bug fix play hands its builder the test's path, which the pages name as built against the rule.

question: Does the fix's check run every test the project already had, or only those the fix could touch?
